title: Post-9/11 GI Bill Books and Supplies Stipend Rule
content:
The books and supplies stipend of Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education) is paid only on the Post-9/11 GI Bill levels; flat-rate chapters pay no books stipend.

**Rule.** The stipend is paid to the student in one lump sum at the start of each certified term: the per-credit stipend for each credit certified, multiplied by the benefit level of the tier and kept to the cent, and limited so that the stipends paid in one academic year never exceed the annual stipend maximum multiplied by the benefit level.

**What counts toward the annual limit.** The stipends counted are those paid on the benefit whose payment month falls in the academic year — August 1 through July 31 — that contains the term start.

**Input — judgement — output**

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Credits certified for the term, the benefit level, the per-credit stipend | Per-credit stipend multiplied by the credits, multiplied by the benefit level | The term's stipend before the annual limit |
| Stipends already paid in the same academic year | Does the term's stipend take the year's total above the annual maximum multiplied by the benefit level? | If not, the full stipend; if so, only the amount that brings the year's total to that limit |

**Hypothetical worked figures (70% Benefit Level).** A 12-credit term: $41.67 multiplied by 12 is $500.04, multiplied by 0.7 is $350.028, kept to the cent as $350.03. The yearly limit at this level is $1000.00 multiplied by 0.7, or $700.00. If $500.00 had already been paid in the same academic year, this term's stipend would be limited to $200.00.
